children: Gold's sharp correction could be creating a buying opportunity, with Lyn Alden, Founder of Lyn Alden Investment Strategy, remaining bullish on the precious metal. She sees the $3,200-$3,300 range as a potential support zone, although the current bounce may not mark the bottom. On crude oil, Alden expects prices and refining margins to remain elevated over the next six months amid geopolitical uncertainty but does not expect them to revisit recent highs.

title: Why gold remains attractive despite volatility; Lyn Alden explains
